name: Shield Focus
text:
**Shield Focus** (Combat)

You are skilled at deflecting blows with your shield.

**Prerequisites**: Shield Proficiency, base attack bonus +1.

**Benefit**: Increase the AC bonus granted by any shield you are using by 1.

feature.name: Shield Focus
feature.description: Increase the AC bonus granted by any shield you are using by 1.
feature.descriptionOnly: no path: +1 to the shield's own bonus, which its item holds
